## Type of change

- [ ] Correction to a factual or scope claim
- [ ] New or amended conformance requirement
- [ ] Protocol or schema change
- [ ] Documentation structure or navigation
- [ ] New decision record

## Claim discipline

- [ ] Every statement I added is labelled as fact, proposal, assumption, target, or verified result.
- [ ] I have not described anything as production ready, complete, implemented, or validated without linked evidence.
- [ ] Any figure I added is labelled a target unless a reproducible measurement is linked.
- [ ] Any external standard I cite has an entry in `Architecture/Requirements/STANDARDS-VERSIONS.md`.

## Consistency

- [ ] Terminology follows `GLOSSARY.md`, and new acronyms are added there.
- [ ] Schema changes are reflected in `Architecture/Schemas/` and noted in `Architecture/Schemas/README.md` alignment deltas.
- [ ] A decision change is a new record under `docs/adr/` that supersedes the old one, not an edit to an accepted record.
- [ ] Relative links resolve and no referenced directory is missing.
